instruction: Center all the Heading 2 section headings in this document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(15); pyautogui.press("down", presses=8, interval=0.01); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.scroll(-2)
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully inserted an image from Desktop into the document at the cursor position using Insert > Image menu in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer menus, use Insert > Image, browse file system, select and insert files, interact with document editing UI
metadata.task_rationale: Tests paragraph alignment capability - centering headings requires selecting and formatting multiple paragraphs, a related Writer formatting task using the same document.
metadata.explanation: Task requires centering all Heading 2 paragraphs. Getter reads the docx and extracts alignment for each Heading 2 paragraph. Metric gives partial credit per heading that is correctly centered.

scoring_breakdown.per_heading: 1/N each - Each Heading 2 paragraph correctly centered (N = total Heading 2 count)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads docx file, filters for Heading 2 style paragraphs, and extracts their alignment using python-docx WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH enum
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_alignment') without unwrapping a 'rules' key
Partial credit scoring is well-designed: correct/total ratio rewards each correctly centered heading
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before getter reads it, ensuring changes are persisted to the docx
Complete coverage: instruction requires centering ALL Heading 2 headings, and evaluator checks every Heading 2 paragraph in the document
Edge cases handled: getter returns error dict if file not found, metric returns 0.0 for error results or empty heading lists
